// Code generated by proto-gen. DO NOT EDIT.
import input_constraints from './input_constraints';
export type Rule = { optional: boolean; nullable: boolean; item_nullable?: boolean; collection: string; kind: string; values?: unknown[]; message?: string };
export type EnumBundle = {
    inputs: Record<string, string>;
    messages: Record<string, Record<string, Rule>>;
    operations: Record<string, { discriminator: string; optional: boolean; branches: Record<string, string> }>;
};
const default_bundle = input_constraints as EnumBundle;
function numeric(value: unknown): string | null {
    if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(value)) { return BigInt(value).toString(); }
    if (typeof value === 'string' && /^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(value)) { return BigInt(value).toString(); }
    return null;
}
function visit(bundle: EnumBundle, message: string, input: unknown, prefix = '', depth = 0): string | null {
    if (depth > 128) { return '参数嵌套过深'; }
    if (!input || typeof input !== 'object' || Array.isArray(input)) { return `${prefix} 必须是对象`; }
    const data = input as Record<string, unknown>;
    for (const [name, rule] of Object.entries(bundle.messages[message] || {})) {
        const field = prefix ? `${prefix}.${name}` : name;
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(data, name)) { if (!rule.optional) { return `${field} 不能为空`; } continue; }
        const value = data[name];
        if (value === null) { if (rule.nullable) { continue; } return `${field} 不允许 null`; }
        if (rule.collection === 'list' && !Array.isArray(value)) { return `${field} 必须是数组`; }
        if (rule.collection === 'map' && (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value))) { return `${field} 必须是对象`; }
        const values = rule.collection === 'one' ? [value] : Object.values(value as object);
        for (const [index, item] of values.entries()) {
            if (item === null && rule.collection !== 'one' && rule.item_nullable) { continue; }
            const path = rule.collection === 'one' ? field : `${field}[${index}]`;
            if (rule.kind === 'message') { const error = visit(bundle, rule.message!, item, path, depth + 1); if (error) { return error; } }
            else if (rule.kind === 'number') { const number = numeric(item); if (number === null || !rule.values!.includes(number)) { return `${path} 必须是指定枚举的数字值`; } }
            else if (!rule.values!.includes(item)) { return `${path} 必须是指定枚举的 field_name 或允许值`; }
        }
    }
    return null;
}
export function validate_input_enums_with_bundle(bundle: EnumBundle, typeOrPath: string, input: unknown): string | null {
    const type = bundle.inputs[typeOrPath] || typeOrPath;
    const error = visit(bundle, type, input); if (error) { return error; }
    const operation = bundle.operations[type];
    if (operation) {
        const data = input as Record<string, unknown>; const key = data[operation.discriminator];
        if (key === undefined && operation.optional) { return null; }
        if (typeof key !== 'string' || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(operation.branches, key)) { return `${operation.discriminator} 操作类型无效`; }
        return visit(bundle, operation.branches[key], input);
    }
    return null;
}

export function validate_input_enums(typeOrPath: string, input: unknown): string | null {
    return validate_input_enums_with_bundle(default_bundle, typeOrPath, input);
}
